app.name: Mighty Mike
app.short_description: Wii port of Mighty Mike (Pangea Software / jorio)
app.long_description:
Unofficial Wii homebrew port of Mighty Mike, Iliyas Jorio's modern reimplementation of the 1995 Pangea Software game "Mutant Mike." Rendering runs through opengx (GX-backed fixed-function OpenGL); no game logic was changed to make this run.
CONTROLS
GameCube controller: Control Stick - Move A - Confirm / pause menu select X - Shoot Y - Radar B - Next weapon / back out of menus L / R - Cycle weapons Start - Pause
Wiimote + Nunchuk: Nunchuk stick - Move A - Confirm B - Radar Z - Shoot C - Next weapon Minus - Previous weapon Plus - Pause Home - Exit to the Homebrew Channel
Wiimote only (held sideways, d-pad on the left): D-pad - Move A - Confirm B - Radar 2 - Shoot 1 - Next weapon Minus - Previous weapon Plus - Pause Home - Exit to the Homebrew Channel
USB keyboard (if plugged in): arrow keys, WASD, and the game's other default PC keybindings all work as-is.
